subject: Portal login failing for vendor due to display name casing (investigate)
messages:
From: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@helionparts.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invitation to Redwood supplier portal — Helion Parts

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

We received the Coupa invite this morning but when I click the activation link I get an error page that says "Account not found". I tried twice (attached screenshot). Our account shows up in the invite email as display name "S.KIM" rather than my full email address, and I wonder whether the portal is matching on the display name instead of the email.

This is blocking a PO approval today — can someone look urgently? I attached the login screenshot and a small SAML trace exported from our IdP (we are running PingFederate).

Thanks,
Sylvia Kim
Vendor Relations
Helion Parts
sylvia.kim@helionparts.com

Attachments:
- screenshot_login_error.png (PNG, 487 KB)
- saml_trace.txt (text, 12 KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invitation to Redwood supplier portal — Helion Parts

Hi Sylvia — thanks for the details and the screenshots, that helps.

Quick troubleshooting steps while we investigate:
- Can you try opening the invite link in an incognito window (or a different browser)?
- If you see a field to sign in, try entering your full email (sylvia.kim@helionparts.com) rather than the display name.

I'm looping in Ben from our infra team to look at the SAML assertion and the way we match NameID/attributes for Coupa invites. Marissa, can you confirm whether we sent the invite with NameID=email or NameID=unspecified/displayName? If we used a displayName attribute, that could explain the mismatch.

We'll keep this urgent — if it's blocking a PO we can also manually approve the vendor account on our side and resend a regenerated invite.

Hannah Schmitt

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invitation to Redwood supplier portal — Helion Parts

Thanks for the signal, Hannah & Sylvia — I pulled the assertion we received (linked in Drive) and the audit logs for the invite acceptance window. Preliminary notes: 

- Root cause: Our Coupa integration currently matches incoming SAML NameID exactly (case-sensitive) against the invite token's principal identifier. In this customer's IdP the NameID was the displayName "S.KIM"; their email attribute (EmailAddress) was present but not used for primary matching. The result: our matcher did not find a principal that matched the NameID, so the invite acceptance flow returned "Account not found".

- Short-term mitigation (done): I manually accepted the Helion vendor record using an admin override and regenerated the invite with NameID=email configured. That should let Sylvia complete the activation now.

- Longer-term fix: We will push a small change to the SAML attribute matcher so it performs a case-insensitive comparison and falls back to the email attribute when NameID fails. The change is scoped to the Coupa on-boarding handler only and includes unit tests. Estimated timeline: 48 hours for code + 4 hour maintenance window to deploy non-disruptively.

- Follow-ups: 1) Add a note in the onboarding runbook to request vendors to ensure NameID=email where possible; 2) Add telemetry to alert on NameID/email mismatches.

Sylvia, after the regen invite you should get a new email shortly — please confirm you can accept it. If you still see an error, send us the timestamp and we'll check the logs.

Attachments put in Drive: audit_log_excerpt.csv (redacted). Internal runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/secure/onboard-runbook#saml-nameid

Ben Carter
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
